items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand is up 45% through May. Raising the low end of the 2030 stationary storage range to 1,500-2,000 GWh, up ~9%. Exited the second quarter near record lows in days of lithium salt inventory.

items.headline: Albemarle Corp: Investor Day on Aug 12, 2026 - Slides
items.snippet: Maintaining total company 2026E outlook. Lithium price scenarios: $10/kg LCE -> net sales $4.1-4.3B, adj. EBITDA $0.9-1.0B; $20/kg -> $5.7-6.0B and $2.4-2.6B; $30/kg -> $7.5-7.8B and $4.2-4.4B.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares, citing cost efficiencies, capital discipline and resilient lithium demand against constrained supply.

items.headline: Albemarle Corp: Q2 2026 Earnings Call on Aug 6, 2026 - Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand is up 45% through May, primarily driven by continued strength in stationary storage. We now expect stationary storage battery production of 900-1,100 GWh in 2026, up 11% from our prior forecast. Lithium demand growth continues to outstrip supply growth.
